title: Document root key provisioning and trust-anchor pinning
description: Document root key provisioning and trust-anchor pinning.
acceptance: Documents how the root key pair is generated and how its kid is confirmed by the operator out of band
States that clients pin the root public key and issuer in configuration and never fetch them
Documents how the controller identity is pinned for session records
Documents root rotation by re-pinning with an overlap, and the steps after a suspected root compromise
findings: From the repository audit of 2026-10-17: metadata cannot establish trust in its own root key, so the initial trust anchor needs a documented, authenticated provisioning procedure.
